purpose: Comparison for short Chinese anime-production/meta danmaku binary decisions; not a 19-category benchmark.

platform.thread_counts: Recorded separately per method; not normalized.

label_definition.positive: Anime production, drawing, storyboarding, budget, static/PPT, CG, frame/3D production talk

data_provenance.pool_335: 335 manually reviewed real Bilibili comments (135 positive / 200 negative), with 18 ambiguous excluded from 353 annotated source comments.
data_provenance.sample_40: Fixed stratified subset of the 335: 20 positive / 20 negative, sampled with a recorded 20261016 seed.
data_provenance.data_distribution: Convenience/review sample, not a randomly drawn, deployment-representative distribution.
data_provenance.leakage: The historical EmbeddingGemma classifier and current 19-category rule family were tuned using overlapping annotated data; this is in-sample development evidence. Threshold and prompt exploration also reused cases.
data_provenance.copyright_and_privacy: Only aggregate metrics are published. Raw Bilibili comments, case identifiers, original manual annotations, private model logs and per-row predictions are not distributed.

methods.notes: Exactly shipped v1.3 policy (two production-related classes activated); this preset participates in prior category tuning.
Older production-topic-specific optimized classifier, NOT identical to the current 19-category runtime.

methods.setup: OR(production,budget,drawing,ppt,3d) with p_yes >= 0.55; no supervised fine-tuning
methods.notes: Five independent yes/no topics (production, budget, drawing, PPT, 3D) combined with OR.
Multilingual direct 3-label production vs story vs other; Chinese char tokenizer.
Seven independent production-related heads combined with OR; no fine-tuning.

methods.setup: Four heads OR @0.50 chosen on this same 40-item evaluation set
methods.notes: Post-hoc selected on the reported cases; use only as an optimistic in-sample upper reference, not held-out performance.
Current shipped runtime on all 335; only the two anime-production categories were active.
Current shipped runtime, alternate profile on identical data.
Older, narrower classifier calibrated on this corpus. Do not attribute to current published 19-category runtime.
No supervised fine-tuning for this particular Bilibili task; initial prompts screened against 12 examples.
High recall but many false positives for this domain; some prompt selection on earlier examples.

observations.workflow: complete classify() calls, including regex short-circuit; 97 of 335 invoked an embedding
observations.notes: Mixed work: median 0.01ms reflects many cheap non-embedding decisions; not representative of embedding-only latency.

observations.workflow: 96 unique texts, batch=1; tokenizer + model + 768d similarities, warm engine
observations.notes: Historical specialized prototype; not same 335/40 workload as current model.

observations.workflow: one direct 3-label classification per text, warm model
observations.notes: 335 manually labeled comments; Chinese char tokenizer.

observations.workflow: seven independent yes/no heads in a single API call, warm model
observations.notes: Same 335 but multiple heads; not the direct 3-way scoring configuration.

observations.workflow: one noul yes/no question per text; warm PyTorch reference implementation
observations.notes: Only 5 samples; no p95 claimed. CPU path is unoptimized; not comparable with vendor MI325X GPU performance.

observations.workflow: seven noul yes/no questions evaluated in one system_one call; warm CPU implementation
observations.notes: Same 40-item sample as accuracy experiment, but more questions than minimal OR baseline.

latency.warning: Measurements use different model runtimes, thread counts, workload sizes and decision question counts. Ratios are descriptive only; no cross-hardware winner is inferred.

limitations: Quality results are not independent held-out estimates.
40-item balanced subset does not reflect real-world prevalence.
Comparators were not identically fine-tuned/optimized for Chinese Bilibili content.
F1 close differences, especially 0.833 vs 0.826 on 40, do not establish a robust ranking.
Current v1.3 19-category runtime was evaluated here only as a TWO-CATEGORY anime-production binary classifier; no external 19-way head-to-head benchmark.
No GPU numbers are implied from the CPU experiments.
Weight bytes are on-disk checkpoint sizes, not process RAM usage.
